576K likes, 1,396 comments - kritisanon on October 30, 2026: "When the Wolfpack gets Obsessed! 👻

It was such an incredible experience to lend my voice for a performance that absolutely blew my mind!! @indenavarrette was beyonddd phenomenal in Obsession and gave me goosebumps yet again in the dubbing room! 🙌🏻🫣

What a film!! With extraordinary performances!! Glad to be associated with it in a small little way! 💖 @themichaeljohnston @curry.barker 

Watch it now on The Peacock Hub on @jiohotstar !".

261K likes, 3,297 comments - jiohotstar on October 29, 2026: "There’s something special about getting to experience a story you love in a whole new way, and we’re so excited to bring this to you!

Kriti Sanon as the voice of Nikki and Varun Dhawan as the voice of Bear in Hindi, with Amar Kaushik bringing it all together.

Obsession: The Original Uncut Version premieres 30th October, 7 PM onwards, exclusively on The Peacock Hub on JioHotstar.".

This Halloween, be careful what you wish for.".
